guitar.modelsText: Les Paul-style (Ray Toro) / Squier Telecaster (Frank Iero)
guitar.notes: Frank Iero is well documented playing Squier/Fender Telecasters with custom finishes; Ray Toro favored Les Paul-style guitars.

tone.target: anthemic modern rock with clean arpeggios and big Marshall crunch
tone.profile: anthemic modern rock with clean arpeggios and big Marshall crunch
tone.summary: A versatile chain starting with a boost for clarity, followed by the UK 45 amp model to capture the Plexi crunch. The US Deluxe provides clean headroom for verses, while the Plate reverb and Digital Delay add necessary depth and space.
